Electrical works and electrical infrastructure

Discuss a project See scope of work
The TPI LUX principle Safety and stability

Electrical solutions are designed around safety, stable operation, certified equipment and long-term use.

Scope of work

What this service covers

The outline is drawn from working material and presented here in the format of a commercial page.

Cable lines and networks

Power and distribution lines, cable laying, installation of routes, trunking and connection points.

Design of electrical systems

Consumption analysis, load calculations, power supply diagrams and technical documentation.

Switchgear equipment

Distribution boards, power control cabinets, protective automation and overload protection.

Installation of cable lines

Laying of power cables, cable routes and protective trunking, and organisation of connections.

Power supply for equipment

Power supply for lighting, engineering systems, structures and site equipment.

Commissioning and maintenance

Network testing, load checks, equipment diagnostics and service support.

Engineering accountability

Why TPI LUX

A complete approach to the project: concept, design, procurement, installation, commissioning and maintenance under a single responsibility.

The team works on large sites where deadlines, safety, quality control and clear communication matter.

Solutions are chosen for the site and for how it will be run, not only for how it looks on day one.
